ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHERFORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHERFORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_check IS
 check_dup number;
 temp number;

BEGIN
 
/* Check in the database */

select count(*) into temp from valid_strong_reactivity where
 epitope_id_1=:valid_strong_reactivity.epitope_id_1 and 
 epitope_id_2=:valid_strong_reactivity.epitope_id_2;

if temp > 0 then
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
end if;

/* check in the buffer */

 
 if nvl(:global.epitope_id_1,' ') != nvl(:valid_strong_reactivity.epitope_id_1,' ') or
 nvl(:global.epitope_id_2,' ') != nvl(:valid_strong_reactivity.epitope_id_2,' ') then
 
 check_insert_rg('antigen_rg0','C06C06',:global.epitope_id_1||','
 ||:global.epitope_id_2||',','D',check_dup); 
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('antigen_rg0','C06C06',:valid_strong_reactivity.epitope_id_1||','
 ||:valid_strong_reactivity.epitope_id_2||',','C',check_dup);

 if check_dup = 1 then
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('antigen_rg0','C06C06',:valid_strong_reactivity.epitope_id_1||','
 ||:valid_strong_reactivity.epitope_id_2||',','U',check_dup);
 
 end if;

END;
